summary: Tested Invite Studio backend (6 pytest cases) and frontend new features (font tool, attribution, drag block, gated preview). Found and FIXED a critical runtime bug in editor.tsx: missing imports for FONT_OPTIONS and FontChoice caused tool-font tap to crash with 'ReferenceError: FONT_OPTIONS is not defined'. After fix, all flows pass with 0 console errors.

issues: Cosmetic RN-web warnings persist: 'shadow* style props deprecated' (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents deprecated'. Functional impact: none.

action_items: (Optional) Update Tool type in editor.tsx to include 'font' (currently typed as 'text'|'background'|'color'|'ai' but used with 'font') — TS will eventually flag this; runtime is fine.
critical_code_review_comments: editor.tsx imports were missing FONT_OPTIONS and FontChoice from @/src/types/invite even though both are used inside the panel-font block (lines 388/393). This is the bug fixed below. Recommend running `tsc --noEmit` in CI to catch such omissions before runtime.

Tool union type in editor.tsx (line 36) is `'text' | 'background' | 'color' | 'ai'` and is missing 'font'. The setter uses string casts so it works at runtime, but the union should be updated for type-safety.

preview/[id].tsx onPay sets `success_url` to a relative-style path on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Backend appends `?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}&invite_id=<id>` — works because Stripe substitutes session_id; verified the session is `cs_*` and url is on the Emergent stripe-proxy host.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_invite_api.py (added Stripe payment tests: status-initial, create-checkout-session, status-after-session)
seed_data_creation: MongoDB paid_invites: created 'test_inv_1' and 'TEST_inv_status_only_unique_xyz' as pending sessions during tests. Cleaned old 'test_inv_1' pre-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metro is in CI mode (no watch reload). After editing frontend code you MUST `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and wait ~8s for tunnel to come back. Stripe via Emergent proxy works with sk_test_emergent against https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe — checkout_url returned is on that host (not checkout.stripe.com directly), session_id starts with 'cs_'. Image generation (~20s) so use 120s timeouts.
rca_of_issue: BUG: Tapping tool-font in the editor crashed the screen with 'ReferenceError: FONT_OPTIONS is not defined'. RCA: editor.tsx (line 388) renders FONT_OPTIONS.map and passes f.id as FontChoice (line 393), but the import statement only brought in `Invite` from @/src/types/invite. Reproduction: open editor → tap tool-font → red screen. Mitigation: Changed import to `import { type Invite, FONT_OPTIONS, type FontChoice } from '@/src/types/invite'`. Verified: panel-font panel mounts, all 3 font options render, switching fonts produces 3 distinct computed font-families (PlayfairDisplay_700Bold → DancingScript_700Bold → DMSerifDisplay_400Regular), save flow navigates to /preview/[id] with correct gated UI.
